name: claude-interrogate-clickup
description: Companion plugin to claude-interrogate: mirrors taskout RC checklists one-way into ClickUp via ClickUp's official MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Mirror taskout RC checklists into ClickUp sprints
interface.longDescription: Companion to claude-interrogate. Exports release-candidate taskout files via the tracker-neutral design_taskout_export tool and mirrors them one-way into ClickUp Folders/Lists (or existing sprints) using ClickUp's official remote MCP server — with a strict 300-calls-per-24h budget ledger, bulk operations, idempotent crash recovery, and a pending-ops queue. Markdown stays canonical; ClickUp is the mirror.
defaultPrompt: Sync my RC checkbox state into ClickUp
How much ClickUp call budget is left?
